Court No. - 84
Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 361 of 2023

Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Dubey
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pawankumar Dubey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Prabhat Kumar Singh,Rajat Singh
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for both sides and learned Aga for the State.

2. This application under Section 407 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by Smt. Priti Dubey against State of
U.P. and another, with a prayer for allowing transfer application in Case No. 724 of 2021, under
Section 125 Cr.P.C., Police Station Bhelupur, District Varanasi, pending in the Court of Additional
Principal Judge, Family Court, Varanasi, to competent jurisdiction at District Allahabad.

entities.text:
Additional
Principal Judge, Family Court, Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3.  It is further submitted that the case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. as mentioned above was filed by opposite party no.2 at Family Court, Varanasi alleging harassment and cruelty for demand of additional dowry on the part of her in-laws.

She also lodged an F.I.R. against the applicant and other in-laws as Case Crime No.348 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Bhelupur, District Varanasi and when in connection with the pairvi of the case, the applicant came to the Varanasi Court, he was threatened by opposite party Ashish Kumar Dubey vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34009318/
1 no.2 and her family members and was not permitted to make an entry in the court premises and the matter was complained of to the police by the applicant.

entities.text: Ashish Kumar Dubey vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is next submitted that due to threats of life, the applicant could not appear before the court of Additional Family Judge, Family Court,
Varanasi and due to his non-appearance, the case was proceeded as ex-parte. It is next submitted that against opposite party no.2 and her family members, four cases are already pending in the District, Allahabad as Case Crime No.835 of 2021, under Sections 506, 507, 452 I.P.C., Complaint Case No.7737 of 2021 under Sections 323, 504, 452 I.P.C., Matrimonial Case No.2065 of 2021 under Section 11 of Hindu Marriage Act and a Complaint Case under Section 494 I.P.C.

entities.text:
Additional Family Judge, Family Court,
Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is next submitted that the father of the opposite party no.2 has his own house at Allahabad and the applicant has also taken house on rent in Mohalla Naini, Allahabad.

It is also submitted that since four cases are already pending against opposite party no.2 at District Allahabad, it will be convenient for her also if the case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. filed by her at the court of Additional Family Judge/Family Court, Varanasi is transferred to Allahabad.

It is further submitted that opposite party no.2, as a matter of fact, has already been married with one Abhishek Pandey prior to her marriage with the applicant and a case for the declaration of his marriage as null and void has been filed by the applicant.

It is next submitted that under these circumstances, it will be proper if the case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. pending at the Court, Varanasi is transferred to the court of competent jurisdiction at District Allahabad and it will be also convenient for opposite party no.2 because she is residing at Allahabad.

Learned counsel for the applicant has relied upon the judgment in the case of Anju Vs. Pramod 2005(11) SCC 186 & Jaswant Singh Vs. Barinder Kaur and another TA No.635 of 2011 before the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh, decision dated 23.05.2012 but the factual aspect of the aforesaid cases, laws differ from the present one,

entities.text: Jaswant Singh Vs. Barinder Kaur and another TA No.635 of 2011
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Hence, the aforesaid case laws did not help the applicant in this matter.
4. Counter affidavit has been filed by the opposite party no.2 although none is present on behalf of her today to argue the matter.

However, in the counter affidavit the allegations levelled in the transfer application have been categorically denied that it has been specifically mentioned therein that opposite party no.2 is presently living in her parental house at Varanasi and the plot situated in Prayagraj is registered in the name of her father and she is not the owner thereof and she visits Allahabad only in connection with the pairvi of the cases which are running at Allahabad.
She has a female child aged about two years and due to all these hardships, it is not possible and convenient for her to visit Allahabad for the pairvi of aforesaid cases.
She had never married with Abhishek Pandey as alleged in the application.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer but however he could not dispute the factual aspect of the matter.
6. In view of the above discussions, the prayer made by the applicant in this application is refused and the application is rejected.
7. The application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 11.1.2024 Shivangi  Ashish Kumar Dubey vs State Of U.P.
